title: Elastic Observability Review (2026)
intro: Elastic Observability is evaluated here as an observability and infrastructure monitoring suite — Elastic Observability is Elastic’s metrics, logs, traces, and APM solution on Elastic Cloud — not the Elasticsearch search product alone. Elastic Cloud Hosted Standard publishes as low as $99/month for a small production config (120 GB storage / 2 zones on elastic.co/pricing/cloud-hosted). Serverless Observability is usage-based ingest (commonly cited ~$0.07–$0.09/GB). Self-managed Elastic Stack remains a separate OSS/licence path. Same observability-monitoring cluster as Datadog and Grafana Cloud. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Elastic Observability when Elastic Cloud telemetry (not search-only Elasticsearch) is the job — not Datadog host modules by default.
verdict: Choose Elastic Observability when Elastic Cloud telemetry (not search-only Elasticsearch) is the job — not Datadog host modules by default. Compare Grafana Cloud for OSS-aligned managed telemetry; Datadog or Splunk Observability Cloud for host-priced suites. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Elastic Cloud plus cluster sizing is more ops-heavy than Datadog host tiles. Not a lab test.
Observability solution on Elastic Cloud — cluster peer of Datadog/Grafana Cloud, not a search-only SKU.
Logs, metrics, traces, and APM on Elastic are deep; Hosted vs Serverless vs self-managed is the packaging tax.
Beats/Agent, cloud, and API ecosystem are the integration story.
Cloud subscription tiers gate support/SLA; enterprise security is real on paid Cloud.
Hosted resource scaling and serverless ingest both scale; TCO follows data.
Published $99 hosted floor plus OSS self-managed path is clearer than Dynatrace DPS. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI is not the Elastic Observability buying reason versus telemetry depth.
